source_text: Nawalan ako ng kapatid at kaibigan, at habang ako'y nasa daan ay may dalawang taong may kapansanan na nasa mga silyang may mga gulong (wheelchair), ang mga tao ay tumatakbo at tumutulak sa kanila," ani Armand Versace.
english: "I lost a sibling and a friend, and while I was on the road there were two disabled people who were in chairs with wheels (wheelchairs), people were running and pushing them," said Armand Versace.
